The structure of Dy8Si4Pt8 (reduced formula Dy2SiPt2) crystallizes in the triclinic space group P-1 (No. 2), with 20 atoms per unit cell distributed over nine independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis shows Dy centers with 11- and 12-coordinate environments, Pt centers with 9- or 11-coordinate environments, and Si centers with 9 neighbors, the geometric neighbor graph forming a single 3-periodic component. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner, edge, and face sharing between Dy 11- and 12-vertex polyhedra, and corner and edge sharing between Dy 12-vertex and Pt 9-vertex polyhedra.
